purpose: Defines high-level scientific agenda and priority policy. The agenda influences background attention, recommendations, capacity requests, and competence maintenance; it never directly grants hidden technology, bypasses prerequisites, or multiplies project RP as a generic bonus.

priority_levels.meaning: Maintain only essential awareness/competence unless circumstances force reconsideration.
Meaningful policy attention and capacity preference.
High institutional attention and strong capacity-development preference.
Civilization-level urgent priority justified by recognized circumstances or explicit policy.

agenda_state.problem_priorities: sparse map recognized Research Pressure id -> priority level
agenda_state.capability_priorities: sparse map recognized cross-lineage capability id -> priority level
agenda_state.basic_vs_applied_orientation: 0..100; low favors exploratory/basic science attention, high favors currently visible applied/engineering work
agenda_state.competence_preservation_policy: 0..100 willingness to preserve broad training/practice even when no immediate project uses it
agenda_state.portfolio_diversity_policy: 0..100 preference for maintaining multiple viable scientific solution families rather than overconcentrating
agenda_state.foreign_science_engagement: 0..100 willingness to analyze/buy/exchange foreign science when politically permitted

player_control.can_request_capacity_focus: Player policy can request more labs/facilities/training in a field; construction/economy/governance systems decide whether those physical investments occur.
player_control.reason: The player guides civilization priorities without having supernatural knowledge of the hidden possibility graph.

background_science_distribution.description: Unassigned lab/background-science effort is preferentially distributed among already recognized fields/problems according to agenda and scientific culture.
background_science_distribution.may_affect: field competence growth, evidence processing attention, bounded basic-science review sampling among legitimately reachable fields
background_science_distribution.does_not: directly expose a named unknown node or add a project RP multiplier

visible_project_recommendation.description: Agenda changes recommendation/ranking among currently visible Investigable projects.
visible_project_recommendation.does_not: remove authoritative blockers or make an unavailable project researchable

capacity_demand.description: Agenda can generate desired capacity requests for labs, specialized facilities, training pipelines, samples, and foreign expertise.

competence_maintenance.description: High preservation priority directs background effort/training toward keeping strategically valued active competence from atrophying.

foreign_science_attention.description: Can prioritize evaluation/assimilation of legitimately known foreign packages/assets; cannot create knowledge of unknown foreign technology.

research_capacity_requests.rule: Requests are planning signals. Adaptive Research does not create buildings, money, materials, experts, or contracts itself.

review_triggers: new major evidence or foreign capability observation
major war outcome or fleet-performance change
major economic/resource constraint supplied by owning subsystem
government/culture change supplied by owning subsystem

complacency_interface.description: A field/capability can receive less strategic attention when the civilization legitimately perceives existing performance as adequate and sees little credible threat/need. This is emergent agenda behavior, not an ahead-of-pack penalty.
inputs: legitimately observed competitor/threat performance with uncertainty
complacency_interface.effect: changes agenda attention/recommendations/capacity requests; never applies a direct research-speed penalty

priority_conflict_resolution.description: A civilization can want many things at once but lab capacity, institutions, economy, and political support are finite.
priority_conflict_resolution.method: Agenda produces ranked planning demands; actual active directed programs remain constrained by directed-program capacity and physical eligible labs.
